name.description: A shell variable's name, not the runner's own, which begin KNOTLESS_RUN.

var.description: A variable a requested run's steps see.

env.description: With workflow, variables its steps see, over the workflow's own of the same names.

ref.description: The full ref name to run again, such as refs/heads/main.

pull.description: The dev.knotless.pull record whose head to run again.

repo.description: The repository, which is the owner's.

workflow.description: The name of the one workflow to run at the ref, or of the pull's.

main.description: Kept in the account of the repository's owner, keyed `<repo key>.<tid>`. A runner acts on the requests in the owner's account, newer than the last it acted on, and on no one else's; it runs the ref or the pull's head where it points when the runner reads it. Naming neither a ref nor a pull asks for nothing. With a ref and a workflow, it runs only that workflow there, its steps seeing env: one that runs on a push to the ref, or one whose trigger is to be asked for. With a pull and a workflow, it runs only that one of the pull's workflows, where the pull is.

description: A repository owner's request that its runners run a ref's or a pull's workflows again.
